digest.component_or_area: terraform drift gate / CI / Gerrit integration
propositions: Terraform drift workflow does not run on Gerrit changes, only on pull_request, push to main, or scheduled runs, allowing un-applied terraform to be submitted and merged without detection.
A terraform change receives Verified +1 based on passing gate checks that do not include drift validation, creating false signal that infrastructure is live when HCL resources remain unapplied.
The 34cd change added CloudWatch alarm resource in HCL that was never applied to AWS, remained undetected until post-merge terraform-drift run, and subsequently broke main until manual apply.
Terraform landing and applying are separate acts with no enforcement that both occur before considering a change complete, unlike code changes where CI green implies done.
Current workflow triggers (pull_request, push, schedule, workflow_dispatch) structurally cannot gate pre-submit on Gerrit because Gerrit changes are neither PRs nor direct pushes to main.
